properties.site-address: Highways Depot, Tonbridge Road, Chiddingstone Casueway
properties.notes: The site comprises a highways depot containing a storage building and area of hardstanding. Bounded by Tonbridge Road to the north, the railway line to the south, and residential units to the east and west, beyond which is the village green. Mature trees line the boundary with the railway line.
